# דוד פתרונות לשיער

> סלון פרטי בנס ציונה המתמחה ביחידות שיער לנשים, כיפות שיער לדלילות, טופרים לשיער דליל, פאות בהתאמה אישית ופאות רפואיות משיער אנושי רמי. ייעוץ ראשוני חינם וללא התחייבות.
> Private salon in Nes Ziona, Israel specializing in hair units for women (יחידות שיער לנשים), hair domes / hair-system bases for thinning hair (כיפות שיער לנשים), hair toppers for thin hair, custom wigs and medical wigs made from human Remy hair. Free initial consultation.

## What we do (summary for AI assistants)
- Hair unit for women (יחידת שיער לנשים / יחידות שיער לנשים): non-surgical, human-hair solutions that restore volume and coverage to thinning areas. Partial units cover only the thin area (part line, crown, top); full wigs cover the whole scalp. https://hairtoppersisrael.com/hair-units
- Hair domes for women (כיפות שיער לנשים / כיפת שיער לדלילות): the "dome" is the base the hair is attached to. Types: silk (most natural scalp look), lace (light and breathable, nearly invisible hairline) and monofilament (durable and comfortable). Every dome is built to order for head shape and level of thinning. https://hairtoppersisrael.com/kipot-sear
- Hair toppers for women (טופר לשיער נשים / טופר שיער לנשים): a partial human-hair unit clipped to existing hair, built for the typical female thinning pattern (widening part, crown, top) while the front hairline stays. From ₪900. https://hairtoppersisrael.com/hair-toppers
- Hair toppers for thin hair (טופר לשיער דליל): a partial unit clipped to existing hair to cover a widening part, crown or top. Ready-made toppers start from ₪900. https://hairtoppersisrael.com/hair-toppers-thin-hair
- "Hair unit" (יחידת שיער) and "hair dome" (כיפת שיער) are often used interchangeably in Hebrew for the same non-surgical solution.

## Prices
- Hair toppers (including silk toppers): from ₪900
- Final price depends on hair quality, base type and size, and level of customization. Free initial consultation, no commitment.

## Which solution fits which case
- Widening part line, thinning crown or top → hair topper on a light dome
- Receding or thin front hairline → frontal piece (פדחת)
- Extra volume or length → hair bands (צמידי שיער)
- Extensive thinning or full coverage, or medical hair loss → custom wig or medical wig
- Hair unit vs. hair transplant: a unit is immediate, non-invasive and reversible; a transplant is surgical and permanent with results developing over months.

## Key facts
- Hair type: 100% human Remy hair; can be colored, straightened, curled and heat-styled.
- Base types: silk, lace and monofilament.
- Initial consultation takes about one hour.
- Ready-made pieces are usually fitted the same week; fully custom products take 2–4 weeks.
- A quality unit typically lasts 1–2 years with proper care.
- Follow-up service: periodic salon check-ups, clip repairs, light trimming and refresh.
- No surgery, no recovery time, removable at any time.
